source_intervention: TimeSeriesBucketsHashTableGrower initial capacity16->2 cells, reserve minimum16->2, fill arithmetic bufSize()/2+bufSize()/4. One empty cell at capacity2; original3/4 fill limit for capacity>=4. No R32 or R35 change.
build_contract: Exact same pinned source, LLVM22.1.8 O2 jemalloc and byte-identical recorded CMake options
correctness: 75 aggregate-family compatibility cases against stock passed, including duplicate/out-of-order timestamps, NaN/Inf/stale payload, partial-state merges and stock-created persisted state roundtrips. Complete independent native fixture oracle passed on every timed request.

kernel_experiment.protocol: Fresh-server stock/candidate/candidate/stock, two warmups plus four measurements per case per phase; output fingerprints/counts checked

sparse_200000_groups.interpretation: About68% less aggregate-only query memory. This is not a68% full native PromQL memory reduction.

dense_8192_groups_128_samples.interpretation: No meaningful dense-memory change. Extra growth steps did not show a clear latency regression in this small control.

native_133000_series.fixture: 250 builds/day x38 stages/build x14days, RAW_UUID, one sample per series; unchanged physical data
native_133000_series.query: avg by(stage)(avg_over_time(ci_duration[1d])) via native prometheusQueryRange,14 daily steps
native_133000_series.protocol: Fresh-server stock/candidate/candidate/stock; two warmups plus four measurements per selector per phase

stage.decision: No reliable latency improvement; observed slowdown is within the substantial control drift.

project.decision: No reliable latency or query-memory improvement beyond drift.

limitations: Small local pilot under4-vCPU/4-GiB cgroup. No large-scale native R34 paired result, production write/read stress or combined R34+R35 result. Do not multiply these gains with R35. Kernel memory savings and whole-query memory savings are different quantities.
next_gate: Separate combined-source integration only after full native mixed-density, concurrency and serialization safety coverage.
